# Lakeshore Demo Video Shot List

Created: 2026-06-05

Purpose: recording checklist for the Lakeshore buyer-proof video. Use this with `LAKESHORE_DEMO_VIDEO_STORYBOARD_2026-06-05.md`.

## Recording Setup

| Setting | Recommendation |
|---|---|
| Target length | 4-6 minutes |
| Recording format | 16:9, 1440p or 1080p |
| Starting artifact | `docs/build/lakeshore-proof/LAKESHORE_ABARVA_VS_RAW_LLM_PROOF_2026-06-05.html` |
| Backup stills | `docs/build/lakeshore-proof/assets/` |
| Tone | Executive, calm, evidence-first |
| Must say | Planning values are not realized savings; AI proposes, humans approve |
| Must not say | Kyriba is live; full approval ledger is populated; Final4 had zero watch items |

## Shot Checklist

| Shot | Duration | Visual / file | Framing | Narration cue | Guardrail |
|---:|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 10s | HTML proof page header | Full page top, proof metrics visible | "AbarVa is not a raw LLM answer box." | State synthetic demo tenant if asked. |
| 2 | 20s | `assets/01-data-trust.png` | Zoom to context/data trust posture | "Context comes first: what is loaded, trusted, and missing." | Do not imply every ledger approval is complete. |
| 3 | 25s | Proof page "Why not raw LLM" section | Show raw LLM vs AbarVa comparison | "The difference is evidence, workflow, owner, next action, and gap visibility." | Avoid attacking LLMs; frame as governance layer. |
| 4 | 35s | `assets/03-kyriba-executive-decision.png` | Zoom to executive-decision posture | "AbarVa says what can safely be claimed before go-live." | Say no realized Kyriba value is claimed. |
| 5 | 25s | `assets/05-kyriba-documents.png` | Show persisted documents/evidence area | "The answer is attached to artifacts and review state." | Mention full setup/admin approval ledger gap. |
| 6 | 35s | `assets/04-kyriba-move-detail.png` | Show Move detail and rollout state | "Failure modes become gates: connectivity, feeds, entity hierarchy, history, adoption, reconciliation." | Acknowledge some QA answers needed richer finance depth. |
| 7 | 30s | `assets/02-kyriba-strategy.png` | Show Source strategy stage | "Sequence critical banks first and keep tail banks from stalling the program." | Integration timeline and readiness assessment still needed. |
| 8 | 30s | `assets/06-tower-value.png` | Zoom to value/control-tower posture | "Tower keeps value, pressure, and governance visible." | Planning values only, not realized savings. |
| 9 | 25s | `assets/07-intelligence-ask.png` | Show ask/answer experience | "The executive gets answer, evidence, gap, owner, and next move." | Human must approve before material action. |
| 10 | 20s | Proof page honesty section | Full section | "This is what makes the demo credible: it says what is proven and what is not." | Keep 12 watch items visible. |
| 11 | 20s | Proof page close | Full close | "AbarVa helps decide what to do next, what evidence supports it, and who must approve." | End without overclaiming. |

## Optional Live Recording Path

2. Start at the header and proof strip.
3. Scroll to "Why not raw LLM."
4. Scroll to Vignette 1 and pause on the Executive Decision screenshot.
5. Scroll to Vignette 2 and pause on Move Detail and Documents.
6. Scroll to Vignette 3 and pause on the Source strategy screenshot.
7. Scroll to Tower / value posture.
8. End on Honesty / close.

## Narration Snippets

Use short sentences and leave room for the screenshot to breathe.

### Opening

> The question is not whether a model can draft a treasury rollout answer. The question is whether the answer is grounded, tied to workflow, honest about gaps, and safe for a CFO to act on.

### Context

> AbarVa starts by showing what context exists and what still needs evidence. That is the foundation for safer AI.

### Decision

> Before Kyriba is live, AbarVa should not claim realized value. It should show the decision state, owner, evidence, and what remains in review.

### Rollout Gates

> The rollout does not fail because strategy is hard to write. It fails because connectivity, feeds, hierarchy, adoption, reconciliation, and ownership are not governed.

### Close

> AbarVa turns a good AI answer into a governed next move: evidence, owner, gap, workflow, and human approval.

## Post-Recording QA Checklist

| Check | Pass criteria |
|---|---|
| Logo | Current AbarVa proof page logo visible; no old nav mark. |
| Claims | No realized Kyriba savings claimed. |
| Watch items | Final4 watch items not hidden. |
| Human control | Human approval mentioned at least once. |
| Value | Value described as planning/forecast unless evidence proves realized. |
| Audio | No rushed reading; key screenshots are held long enough. |
| Buyer questions | End with an invitation to discuss evidence, rollout risks, and what to load first. |
